name: kf-demo-model-card-ui
description: UI contributions of kf-demo-model-card, the tutorial's demo module (React, rendered inside the KF host's React tree through the page import map: react, react-dom, @kf/ui, @kf/host-sdk = window.__KF__). Built by ../build.sh into the jar (static/ui/): ModelCard on models.detail.overview.cards and ModelCardsPage on module.pages (page cards). qrcode-generator 1.4.4 is IN the bundle. Texts are explicit keys in ../kf-module-conf.json (i18n.en / ro, prefix ui.), no i18n sync. Tests: vitest + jsdom from the host UI's node_modules (scripts/run-vitest.mjs, as kf-feedback).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/surfaces.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --jsx=automatic --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react-dom --external:@kf/ui --external:@kf/host-sdk --outfile=dist/surfaces.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/build-css.mjs
